meta.label: DB Health: query runtimedb
meta.description: Run a curated PostgreSQL operation against the DSS runtimedb. Runs as the dataiku service account on the target host so psycopg2 can authenticate via the local socket + .pgpass.

params.name: operation
params.label: Operation
params.description: Operation to perform: test-password, run-query, list-tables.

params.name: sql
params.label: SQL query
params.description: SQL to execute for run-query (read-only enforced).

params.name: connection
params.label: DSS connection name
params.description: Name of the DSS PostgreSQL connection to read credentials from (defaults to plugin setting).

params.name: password
params.label: Unencrypted password (optional)
params.description: Override password when DSS-stored credential cannot be decrypted (e.g. user-bound key).
